classes.name: manifest
classes.reason: Each round wraps the single manifest read (_read_staged) tightly between barrier.wait() at the top and barrier.wait() right after, so every rank must sit at the second barrier until the slowest rank's manifest read finishes, coupling all ranks; this happens once per round for 200 rounds.

classes.name: sidecar
classes.reason: After the manifest barrier, each rank loops over its own sidecars with _read and no barrier immediately follows, so while one rank reads a sidecar the others are doing their own sidecar/shard reads rather than waiting on it; the loop runs sidecars_per_rank(cell) (>=10) times per round across 200 rounds, i.e. 2000 reads per rank.

classes.name: shard
classes.reason: Shard reads occur in the same unguarded stretch after the sidecar loop, executed via the blocking _read call with no barrier separating ranks until the next round's manifest phase, so each rank only blocks itself; cell.shards_per_rank (2) shard reads happen per round for 200 rounds, giving 400 reads per rank.
